description: Set of mutually exclusive alternatives, with labels and descriptions.

howToUse: Use it when only one of a few options can be chosen and the person needs to see all of them to decide: plan, delivery method, visibility.
Give the group a `label` with the question, and each option a short label, with a description when the difference is not obvious.
Start with the safest or most common option selected.
alternatives: Several options can be on at once: Checkbox.
Seven or more options: Select or Combobox.
Choices with image or price that work like cards: ChoiceCard.

keyboard.action: Enters the group on the selected option, and leaves it on the next Tab.
Selects the next or previous option.
